title: Wordris
tagline: Letters tumble one at a time down a narrow well.
blurb: Letters tumble one at a time down a narrow well. Steer each one home and spell a three- or four-letter word, across or down, to score and clear it. Treble-letter and double-word squares reward the greedy, a shadow shows where each letter will land, and every thirty letters the pace quickens.
controls: Restart (in pause or at game over)

quote.text: Sums and spelling in one go: somebody at Dalex has been reading my diary

credits.name: Mandy Pike, Baz Pocket and Stan Hollis for INK & PAPER
